senses.definition: a grand council or grand assembly used to resolve political conflicts or other national problems
examples: he convened a Loya Jirga that persuaded tribal leaders to acquiesce

senses.definition: inspired by love for your country
unwavering in devotion to friend or vow or cause
a person who is loyal to their allegiance (especially in times of revolt)
with loyalty; in a loyal manner
examples: government will not be efficient unless the people as a whole accept leadership loyally and enthusiastically

senses.definition: the act of binding yourself (intellectually or emotionally) to a course of action
examples: his long commitment to public service
they felt no loyalty to a losing team
